title: JudgeBiasProbe: A Tool for Auditing LLM-as-Judge Alignment Evaluation Bias

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Very strong chain: if LLM judges used in RLHF pipelines are biased by surface artifacts, the entire evaluation loop is corrupted. A pre-use audit tool directly prevents a documented failure mode with up to 98% flip rates.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating probe pairs with surface artifact injections and measuring flip rates through API calls is straightforward. No model training needed; uses black-box API access to test judges. Well within beginner capabilities.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five probe types with a clear metric (flip rate) per type. Deliverable is a bias audit report. Well-scoped for 30 hours, especially since the probe methodology is described concretely.
